title: How to become a dental hygienist: education, exams and license
description: The steps to become a dental hygienist in the US: an accredited associate's degree program, the National Board Dental Hygiene Examination, a clinical exam and a state license.
heading: How to become a dental hygienist

byline.sourceNote: Sources are listed at the end of the page.

intro: Every state requires dental hygienists to be licensed, and the requirements differ from state to state (US Bureau of Labor Statistics). The steps below are the usual route. Check the rules for your state on its page.
takeaways: The typical entry requirement is an associate's degree (US Bureau of Labor Statistics).
Dental hygiene programs are accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA).
The national written exam is the National Board Dental Hygiene Examination (NBDHE).
Every state requires a license, and the requirements differ from state to state (US Bureau of Labor Statistics).
